The drawing shows a para-disubstituted benzene ring. One substituent is an ester, C(=O)O–CH2–CH3 (the ethyl group is drawn as H3C–CH2–O). The other is NH2. The molecule is ethyl 4-aminobenzoate (benzocaine). It has no stereocentres, so no stereo marks are needed.

SMILES: CCOC(=O)c1ccc(N)cc1
